_comment: Translation presets and per-model hints. The exact model per preset is fixed after the F1 comparison (docs/subtitle-translation-eval.md). Model hints match the model name (from the server or -model), lowercase substring, first match wins.

model_hints._why: TranslateGemma does not do JSON and has a 2K context: one line per request with its own prompt.
Qwen3 Instruct-2507 has no thinking mode.
Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 hybrid models think by default: wasted tokens and broken JSON. enable_thinking=false in the chat template.
